payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over integer positions 0..max, DP f(i) = max survivors from beacons ≤ i after rightmost activation; if beacon at i, f(i)=1+f(i-1-b_i) else f(i)=f(i-1). Answer n-max_i f(i).
payload.rationale: Problem reduces to choosing added beacon to destroy a suffix, then deterministic chaining on prefix. Code computes max survivors for each prefix via 1D DP on coordinates. Sorting is avoided by direct indexing.
